name: Milk Burger
intro: A burger and Champagne restaurant on Westbourne Grove. The standards of a Michelin-starred kitchen, applied to food you eat with your hands, with a glass of Billecart-Salmon on the side.

hours.detail: The kitchen runs straight through. No break between lunch and dinner.

transport.detail: Circle & Hammersmith and City lines, about a 6 minute walk
Circle & District lines, about a 6 minute walk
Elizabeth line and mainline rail, about 1km

teams.headline: Smash or juicy?
teams.body: Every burger lover is on a team. Alina is smash army. Dima is team juicy. Most places pick a side. Milk Burger does both, properly.

quote.text: I'm smash army and Dima is juicy, so we have both of them.

smash.label: Team Smash
smash.line: Thin, crisp-edged, well done. Cheese everywhere.

juicy.label: Team Juicy
juicy.line: Thick, juicy, aged beef. Napkins essential.

menu.note: Draft menu compiled from press coverage. Dish names and prices to be confirmed by the kitchen.

items.name: Classic Smash
items.description: Two thin, well-done patties, deep orange melted cheese and thick-cut pickles in a glossy milk bun.

items.name: Bone Marrow & Truffle
items.description: The headliner. A thick, juicy patty with bone marrow and truffle.

items.name: Baconnaise
items.description: A thick, juicy patty with our baconnaise: house mayo made with bacon powder. Messy, with a kick.

items.name: Turkey
items.description: Turkey patty with dolce gorgonzola sauce.

items.name: The Mexican
items.description: Beef patty, salsa and avocado, wrapped in a tortilla and fried.

items.name: Cuban
items.description: The Milk Burger take on the classic Cuban sandwich.

items.name: Fried Camembert
items.description: Crisp outside, molten inside, with hot honey.

items.name: Vegetable Tempura
items.description: Vegetables in a light, crisp tempura batter.

items.name: Fries
items.description: Medium-cut, crunchy, properly salted. Chosen after many, many tastings.

items.name: Fried Cherry Pie
items.description: The fried cherry pie you remember, made properly: thirty-odd doughs tested, virgin coconut oil instead of palm oil. With vanilla soft serve.

items.name: Doughnuts
items.description: Rolled in cinnamon sugar, with chocolate soft serve.

items.name: Champagne
items.description: House pour by Billecart-Salmon, by the glass or the bottle.

points.title: Aged beef
points.body: From Mr Txuleta, the aged-beef specialists behind Ibaii in the City.

points.title: Every sauce from scratch
points.body: Baconnaise, dolce gorgonzola, the lot. Nothing comes out of a jar.

points.title: A pie, obsessed over
points.body: More than thirty doughs before the cherry pie was right.

chef.name: Jorge Paredes
bio: Jorge was executive chef at Michelin-starred Sabor under Nieves Barragán, then head chef at OMA and AGORA in Borough Market.
OMA won its first Michelin star in under a year, the first Greek restaurant in the UK to earn one, and was named Michelin Opening of the Year.
At Milk Burger he brings the same standards to food that's meant to be eaten with your hands.
chef.quote: A burger doesn't give you anywhere to hide. The produce, the seasoning, the technique all have to be right.

founders.headline: Built by people who couldn't find the burger they wanted
bio: Alina and Dima opened their first burger restaurant in Kyiv in 2013 and went on to build 32 restaurants there.
After moving to London they settled in Notting Hill, and couldn't find the place they wanted: a great burger, somewhere comfortable and beautiful, with proper cocktails, wine and Champagne.

quote.text: People are tired of overly complicated food, but at the same time we care more and more about the quality of what we eat.

room.headline: Two rooms. Pick your mood.
room.designer: Designed by David Archer, the designer behind Chiltern Firehouse and The Standard.

rooms.name: The tiled room
rooms.body: Intimate and chocolate-box: burgundy tile, stainless steel, rust-red banquettes.

rooms.name: The light room
rooms.body: Airy and calm: pale blue, soft timber, white panelling.

room.details: The two-tone idea runs all the way down to the printed burger papers and the matchboxes.

history.headline: No. 50 has always been a burger address
history.body: This corner of Westbourne Grove served burgers for nearly twenty years before the pandemic closed it. Milk Burger picked up where it left off.

quote.text: The walls remember all the burger success before.

press.quote: Unlike many other viral burger spots, Milk Burger does great desserts worth saving room for.
Will please team smash burger and team juicy burger alike.
Clearly understands our pyramid of needs.
Somewhere you can eat with your hands while drinking something that comes with a cork.
The pinnacle of human achievement or the beginning of the end.
A burger and a glass of fizz is very much the intended order.
All about that high low lifestyle.
Right now the city is in the grips of the chef-led burger.

faq.a: No. We're walk-ins only, every day from 12pm to 9pm.

faq.q: Do you close between lunch and dinner?
faq.a: Never. The kitchen runs straight through from noon until 9pm.
Fried camembert, vegetable tempura, fries and every dessert. Ask about a vegetarian burger.

faq.q: I have an allergy. Can you help?
faq.a: Every sauce is made in our kitchen, so the team can tell you exactly what's in each dish. Please tell your server before you order.

faq.q: Can I hire the restaurant for a party?
faq.a: Get in touch through Instagram and we'll see what we can do.
